method.parser: Exact frozen-input allowlist in private loopback bundle; production parser unchanged; original W2 reservation/memory watchdog retained; 30-minute research timeout
method.wallTime: page request to terminal event, including Worker/loading/build/solve/export/check/clone; excludes browser launch and fingerprinting
method.solveTime: integer-ms engine session clock; browser yielding/finalization included, not pure CPU time; ratios are platform observations, not phone predictions
method.linearMemory: monotonic WASM high-water sampled at events through finish/export; excludes JS and browser memory
method.rss: sampled browser tree plus new same-bundle WebKit XPC companions; baseline/increment reported, shared pages may be double-counted, brief peaks may be missed; not PSS
method.samplingWindow: includes result fingerprinting; sampler adds overhead
method.scope: Frozen full-range local game only, not production play, whole-game safety, or physical-device certification
